title: ranunculus ficaria var. calthifolia
intro: Ranunculus ficaria var. calthifolia, commonly known as lesser celandine or pilewort, is a plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving circulation. Lesser celandine is thought to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus ficaria var. calthifolia include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
